messages:
riley (Sales): Procurement sent a short redline on the POC OF: they want DocuSign ID Check for all signers and a 99.9% SLA with credits up to 10% monthly. POC is 90 days, est $46k. Can legal/eng/finance weigh in?

karim (Legal): Paste the exact language if you have it. High-level: notarization for sub-$250k deals and 99.9% on small dedicated pools are likely pushback items.

riley (Sales): Quote: "Provider shall require identity verification via DocuSign for each signer. Provider guarantees 99.9% uptime; service credits accrue per 0.1% below target up to 10% of monthly fees." No notarization line in this one.

anya (Solutions): We can enable DocuSign ID Check in the envelope. For a small dedicated POC pool the platform typically commits 99.5%; 99.9% is risky because of variance during short windows. Spin-up is 3 business days.

kevin (Engineering): Confirmed. Recommend we counter to 99.5% for POCs, cap credits to the total POC fees, and add measurement/ exclusions: rolling 30-day window, scheduled maintenance (72h notice), customer network, and force majeure excluded.

karim (Legal): Draft counter suggestion: "For Proof-of-Concept engagements, Provider offers a 99.5% uptime SLA. Service credits for POCs are limited to the aggregate fees paid for the POC term. Provider accepts electronic signatures executed via DocuSign; DocuSign identity verification satisfies Provider's signer authentication requirements. Provider is not liable for third-party verification failures." Any objections?

priya (Finance): Finance ok with capping credits to POC fees. We can offer a one-time conversion credit (e.g., 7.5% of POC fees) if Customer signs an annual Dedicated commitment within 60 days of POC completion. We prefer dollar caps in the OF.

riley (Sales): Good. I'll confirm the $46k and respond with the counter. I'll enable ID Check in the DocuSign envelope only if procurement asks, and route signer order to their procurement + legal, our AE, and Karim. Karim, can you upload the redline to the ticket today?

karim (Legal): On it. I'll add the SLA carveouts and the conversion-credit language and upload before EOD.

docusign-bot: DocuSign template "Redwood POC OF" created (tpl_11422). Tip: set Auth = ID Check when requested.

riley (Sales): Thanks team ":thumbsup:" Will escalate if procurement reintroduces notarization or increases credit cap.
